comment: Every security posture a launcher holds or lacks, that somebody has decided to keep.
C25 reads the three launchers (stack-single, stack-k8s, stack-up) and fails on any
posture a launcher does not hold that is NOT recorded here, and on any entry here
that is no longer a divergence.
A key is `<posture>:<launcher>`, the names C25 prints. A value needs a `why`, a
`provenance` and a `recorded` date. The provenance follows the estate convention:
@claude is a reading of the launcher and should be re-checked, @decided is a
decision (paraphrased, never quoted, in a public repository), @measured names the
Recording a gap as a decision is a claim about what somebody decided. A gap goes
here only with its own honest reason, and a launcher that lacks a posture by
accident is fixed in the launcher, not excused here.
